text: also. u gotta fix something a bout the paint carrying over to another model or whatever it happening idk what it is but i keep testing on a basic cube. and then go back to my model of a car im working on and there is a cube in the center of it and its got paint on it and i cant see the grid for paint or paint at all on the car model yet still im assuming something is a problem idk
resolution: Two parts. (1) BUG FIXED — 'can't see grid/paint on the car': switching models resets the global studio:tex twig to null (so paint doesn't carry over), but ensureTexture only ran on the paint-mode button press, so returning to a model while already in paint mode left it textureless → no grid, no paint. Added an effect that auto-ensures a paint-fit texture whenever paint mode is active and the open model lacks one, using an explicit paintFit flag (a texel-size compare would loop since the fit's nextPow2 size varies). (2) The 'cube in the center of the car' is almost certainly a real part added to the car model via the +add button (it adds a cube to the OPEN model) — parts ARE correctly scoped per-model (modelStream.modelParts only returns that model's parts; events carry the model id), so it isn't leaking across models. The user can delete it from the outliner ✕. Studio bundles clean, textureize 10/10, meshPaint 6/6.
